settings.seo_text_1: Compare the available shapes and sizes in the Guillo fit guide. Explore the product views to see the silhouette from every angle.
settings.seo_text_2:
The Luxe Chino is slim and tailored, sitting close without restricting. The Signore is classic with a hint of slim, and its side fastening keeps the front clean under an untucked shirt.

If you train, start with your usual waist. Both cuts are drafted with room through the thigh, so sizing up is rarely the answer.
